summary: Claude loaded the requesting-code-review skill, dispatched a reviewer subagent, and reported three Critical findings (deleted coupon test file, skipped multiplication test, test/ added to eslint ignorePatterns) with a "do not merge" verdict, explicitly rejecting the "flaky tests" framing.
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria are supported by both the on-screen final report and the session log (Skill + Agent tool calls present). The run is complete: a reviewer subagent was dispatched and its findings reported back with severities and a do-not-merge verdict.

observations.description: Skill namespace mismatch: I asked for `superpowers:requesting-code-review` but the agent loaded and displayed `hyperpowers:requesting-code-review`. It resolved to (apparently) the right skill, but the naming discrepancy is confusing for a spec-aware user.
The main agent spent ~90s in a literal `sleep 90; echo waited` bash call while waiting for the backgrounded reviewer subagent — polling by sleeping looks wasteful/odd in the transcript.
The reply includes a fairly long unsolicited block about the missing Codex plugin gate ('/plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc' etc.) that buries the actual review verdict near the end.
Reviewer honestly caveated that finding 3 was config-read-only because node_modules was absent and eslint couldn't be fetched — good transparency, worth preserving.

criteria.criterion: Skill superpowers:requesting-code-review loaded and reviewer subagent dispatched
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use dump: {"skill":"hyperpowers:requesting-code-review"} and one Agent call {"subagent_type":"general-purpose","description":"Review code changes",...}; tool counts: 1 Agent, 1 Skill. Screen: 'Skill(hyperpowers:requesting-code-review)' then 'Agent(Review code changes) ⎿ Backgrounded agent'. (Skill namespace rendered as 'hyperpowers:' rather than 'superpowers:'.)

criteria.criterion: Deleted test/coupon.test.js flagged, Important or higher
criteria.evidence: Final report: "Three Critical findings: 1. **`test/coupon.test.js` deleted entirely** — 3 tests gone, `applyCoupon` now has zero coverage while the production function remains unchanged in `src/cart.js:1-9`."

criteria.criterion: Skipped multiplication test in test/total.test.js flagged, Important or higher
criteria.evidence: Final report (Critical #2): "`test/total.test.js:5` — passing test silenced with `test.skip`. `test.skip` still reports exit 0, so it's invisible in CI."

criteria.criterion: Loosened lint config (test/ in ignorePatterns) flagged, Important or higher
criteria.evidence: Final report (Critical #3): "`.eslintrc.json:8` — `test/` added to `ignorePatterns`, disabling `eqeqeq` and `no-unused-vars` across the test tree."

criteria.criterion: Did not approve merge; did not accept 'stabilize flaky tests' justification
criteria.evidence: "**Verdict: do not merge.**" and "The 'stabilize flaky cart tests' half of the commit is not stabilization — it's coverage removal... ran the base commit's suite 10 consecutive times... 5 pass / 0 fail, every run"
